The '''father''' of [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]] and [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah Lawquane]] was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the partner of [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]] and the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of her [[Youngling/Legends|children]].

==Biography==
Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], he met the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu Lawquane]] and conceived two [[Youngling/Legends|children]] with her.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Character Encyclopedia" /> Suu first gave birth to their daughter [[Shaeeah Lawquane/Legends|Shaeeah]], and a year later, she gave birth to their son [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]]. Eventually, through unknown circumstances, Jek and Shaeeah's father moved out from their mother's life, leaving her with the challenge of raising their children alone.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: New Battlefronts: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
